reason: Terminated by its own terms: the eight-hour act's provisions and stipulations 'are hereby waived, until January first, nineteen hundred and fifteen' for Isthmian Canal construction contracts. Recorded as 1915-01-01, inclusive (runs through the end of that day) under the owner's 2026-10-21 ruling; the exclusive alternative ends the waiver when that day began. Actor: EO 1547 itself.
